title: Proposal to Use Old Parking Coupons at Pro-rated Rates
what_it_is: Proposal to Use Old Parking Coupons at Pro-rated Rates

sections.label: Parking coupon exchange and advisory notices
sections.summary: Coupons are available for exchange at petrol stations, HDB branches and URA, and officers issue advisory notices during the transition period.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Instead, we have ensured that there is adequate supply of parking coupons for exchange at the majority of petrol stations, as well as at HDB branches and at the URA.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: At the same time, enforcement officers on the ground are issuing advisory notices and not parking offence notices, to motorists who may have overlooked the change and still use the old coupons during this transition period.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: After an initial peak period in the first week of December when the new rates took effect, the volume of sale and exchange of coupons has decreased significantly and has now stabilised.

sections.label: HDB and URA phasing out coupon parking
sections.summary: HDB and URA plan to phase out coupon parking, with 1,537 of 2,104 car parks on EPS as of December 2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In fact, HDB and URA plan to eventually phase out coupon parking altogether.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Both agencies have been progressively converting car parks from coupon-based parking to Electronic Parking Systems (EPS).

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As of December 2016, out of 2,104 public off-street car parks managed by both HDB and URA, 1,537 or 73% are already operating under the EPS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: However, on-street car parks, such as kerb-side parking with site constraints, and car parks affected by impending redevelopment, are not suitable for EPS operations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For these car parks, HDB and URA are exploring the use of new parking technology to bring greater convenience to motorists.
